name: Pickled Gulf Shrimp with Satsuma Orange Salad
whyItWorks: Hard avoid under the strict citrus guardrail: pickled in citrus-vinegar brine and served directly with Satsuma orange segments and raw greens.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip this starter due to the Satsuma citrus segments and acidic pickling liquid; order the Sautéed Gulf Shrimp and Grits (sauce on side) instead.
